facts.value: Initializes or reenters a carrier CargoWalk tier through shared walking using Donkey attribute motion base + 1, six animation parameters, Ft_MF_None, anim_start and multiplier 1. Afterwards it requests ShoulderedWait + a recomputed walk type on the referenced victim. Initial entry supplies zero; tier changes supply an integer-quantized phase-derived carrier frame, not exact continuous phase preservation or synchronized victim animation time.
facts.rationale: Confirms and refines the librarian correction to unqualified phase-preservation and victim-change wording.

facts.value: The internal entry has no local guard: shared initialization stores multiplier 1, classifies speed and enters attribute base + 1 + walk type at anim_start, then the entry requests ShoulderedWait + a newly computed walk type on the victim. The victim updater skips work only when current and requested motion both equal ShoulderedWait; otherwise it changes motion at frame zero, optionally using FreezeState. Initial invocation is guarded by the shared walking-input predicate; in-state invocation is guarded by changed selected motion and uses a quantized phase-derived frame without finite or zero-length validation.
facts.rationale: Distinguishes carrier entry, victim request, initial gating and tier reentry.

facts.value: Entry reads the carrier Fighter and Donkey attributes and forwards motion base x4_motion_state + 1, frame parameters x8/xC/x10, rate parameters x14/x18/x1C, anim_start and multiplier 1 to shared walk initialization. It passes victim_gobj and ShoulderedWait + walk type to a victim motion updater, not into the victim_gobj pointer field. Anim and Phys forward gobj unchanged to shared walking helpers; IASA supplies the static entry function to a synchronous non-retaining tier helper; Coll forwards gobj to CargoWait collision handling.
facts.rationale: Replaces ambiguous pointer-write wording with exact object-reference and motion-ID flow.

facts.value: Initial entry through ftCo_8009B67C requires the shared forward-stick walking threshold and starts at frame zero. IASA short-circuits through cargo throw, jump-input preparation, platform pass and CargoWait, then conditionally reenters a changed speed tier without repeating the initial input predicate. Entry requests a corresponding ShoulderedWait-offset victim motion; the updater can skip unchanged ShoulderedWait. Anim and Phys use shared walking logic, while Coll uses CargoWait's conditional CargoFall callback path.
facts.rationale: Corrects universal input-gating and unconditional victim-update implications.
